name: Slerp, inject and unsampler toolkit (BlenderNeko)
plain: A small node set for noise-as-latent workflows. Creates raw noise latents, interpolates them on a hypersphere, adds to a latent, and walks sigmas in reverse. Unsampler uses zero noise so the sampler's own solver acts as the inversion.
math:
Slerp: ω=acos(n̂_a·n̂_b) by batch row; x = sin((1−t)ω)/sinω·a + sin(tω)/sinω·b; near-parallel falls back to lerp.
Inject: z' = z + strength·n, optional mask.
Unsampler: noise=0; sigmas flipped; sampler runs low→high.
GetSigma: (σ_start−σ_end)/scale_factor, a helper for correct inject amplitude.

props.normalizes_variance: no; slerp preserves norm only for near-orthogonal equal-norm inputs

label: from code
surprise: GetSigma returns (σ_start−σ_end) divided by the VAE scale factor, so the inject strength it gives depends on the model's latent format.
